Per-target result notes (from daily reports)

  • S. aureus DHFR (10-12): pipeline hit the plasmid-encoded TMP-resistant dfrA isoform (P13955). Three low-nM organosilicon iminosugar scaffolds (CHEMBL120226 / 332802 / 120488) are genuine scaffold hops off the diaminopyrimidine family; docked −8.23 / −8.00 / −7.70 vs trimethoprim −7.44 (PDB 2W9S, 1.8 Å).
  • P. falciparum DHFR-TS (10-13): K1 resistant isolate structure (PDB 1J3K, 2.1 Å). Analog-series output (2,4-diaminopyrimidines); best analog CHEMBL21885 (p-tert-butyl) docked −8.34 vs −7.45.
  • CDK4 (10-14): CDK6 not modelled (scope limit). Abemaciclib-bound structure 7SJ3 (2.51 Å) used — pocket-bias caveat documented. CHEMBL6008170 docked −7.44 vs palbociclib −6.89.
  • PARP1 (10-15): strongest run of the week. Rediscovery positive (CHEMBL521686 = olaparib, sim 1.00, IC50 0.1 nM). CHEMBL4845834 (−11.87) and CHEMBL493045 (−11.35) scored better than olaparib (−11.27) in the same 6NRH (1.5 Å) grid — within noise, reported as priority candidates, not winners.
  • HMGCR (10-16): rediscovery positive (CHEMBL1487 = atorvastatin). Reference docked best (−8.98, 2R4F, 1.7 Å). Method note: first docking pass mis-centered the grid (tetramer chain averaging); corrected mid-run with _ligand_center grouping by name+chain+seqnum. CHEMBL161829 and CHEMBL2220442 outranked atorvastatin on composite ADMET score (cleaner, 0 Lipinski violations).
  • GLP1R (10-17): 58 bioactivities, 26 ranked. No rediscovery (max lead similarity 0.197 — independent scaffolds). Reference docked −7.74 (PDB 4ZGM, 1.8 Å); best lead −7.20. Top leads are beyond-rule-of-5 scaffolds (MW ~595–637) — the nature of oral small-molecule GLP-1 chemistry.
  • PCSK9 (10-18): reference enlicitide (MK-0616) chosen deliberately over the biologic PCSK9 drugs (evolocumab/alirocumab) and inclisiran (siRNA) — only a small-molecule reference suits the screen. 53 bioactivities (CHEMBL2929), 26 ranked. Top lead CHEMBL5084416 (reported ChEMBL Ki 0.01136 nM — sub-10-picomolar) and CHEMBL5082483 (Ki 0.037 nM), both enlicitide-family macrocycles (sim 0.63 / 0.56). Docking failed honestly: AutoDock Vina was SIGKILLed (OOM) on all five leads and the reference at exhaustiveness 8 and 4 — every ligand is a 1290–1612 Da macrocycle (91–114 heavy atoms), outside Vina's reliable range; a tiny-ligand control on the same receptor (7S5H, 1.27 Å) ran clean, isolating the failure to ligand size. No affinities produced, none reported, no head-to-head winner. Method lesson for the paper: Vina is unsuitable for macrocyclic ligand classes — flag as a stated pipeline limitation (future work: constrained docking / MD). Source: leadforge-daily-PCSK9-2026-10-18.md.

Weekly tallies (final)

  • 7/7 runs completed; 6/7 with docking numbers; 1 (PCSK9) docking infeasible (honest failure, documented).
  • Rediscovery positives: 2 (PARP1, HMGCR) — screen calibration holds.
  • Within-noise "better than reference" candidates: 3 runs (S. aureus DHFR, P. falciparum DHFR-TS, PARP1) — all reported as priority candidates, zero winners declared.
  • Novelty: scaffold hops in 2 runs (S. aureus DHFR organosilicon, GLP1R independent scaffolds); analog series in 4 (Pf DHFR, CDK4, HMGCR, PCSK9); rediscovery-only in 1 top slot (none — all runs found novel lead slots).

Discussion (draft)

  1. Rediscovery is the screen's calibration. Two runs (PARP1, HMGCR) independently re-found the reference scaffold at Tanimoto 1.00 — evidence the similarity screen recovers genuine actives.
  2. Noise discipline kept every head-to-head honest. No run declared a winner; the largest margin (PARP1's +0.60 kcal/mol for CHEMBL4845834) sits inside Vina's ±1 kcal/mol floor and is reported as a priority candidate, not a discovery.
  3. Structure choice shapes the answer. The CDK4 run's abemaciclib-bound pocket (7SJ3) and the resistant-allele DHFR runs show how the experimental structure constrains what the screen can say — documented per-run, not averaged away.
  4. Novelty is uneven. BRAF/SGLT2-style scaffold hops appeared for S. aureus DHFR (organosilicon) and GLP1R (independent scaffolds); CDK4 and P. falciparum outputs were analog series — weaker patent footing, flagged for analog design.
  5. Limitations. Computational only; no synthesis, no assays, no wet-lab validation in this draft. ChEMBL assay heterogeneity, ToxGuard read-across weakness, ±1 kcal/mol docking noise, single-gene runs for CDK4/6 and HER2-style pairs. Weekly cadence means one target per method replicate — no cross-day replicates of the same target.

What this paper is NOT (for the author)

  • Not a discovery claim for any molecule.
  • Not a therapeutic, efficacy, or cure claim for any disease.
  • Not submission-ready: needs Zubair's authorship decisions, target-method narrative, figure set (workflow diagram, docking pose overlays, score distributions), and a chosen venue.
